title: IdeaSeek FullPlan (full-plan-v1)
description: Structural contract for the Full Research plan, mirroring the writer: `ideaseek full plan` computes and persists this artifact to knowledge/full-plan-<ideaId>.json from persisted state (src/full/plan.ts buildFullPlan), with no model in the loop, so the schema accepts exactly what that literal emits. Checked structurally: the tag and identity/hash fields, the readiness gate (ready is a boolean because assertApprovable refuses on false, and readiness is required because approval reads it), the lock and fairness blocks, and the comparison entry types (methodId/status strings when present — the entry's presence set and its boolean `required` flag stay declared in FullPlan). What stays in TypeScript: inputHash recomputation (generatedAt and the live `resources` probe are excluded from it by design), the composition of handoff + fairness blockers into readiness, and the approval gate. Members the writer sets to null when a ceiling or binding is absent — lock.protocol, lock.dataSnapshotId, lock.codeCommit, fairness.inputHash, plus budget.maxModelCost/maxGpuHours/ideaMaxGpuMinutes, timeLimit.ceilingHours and resources.diskFreeGiB — are typed nullable or left untyped inside their deliberately loose group, because a null ceiling is a valid plan, not a malformed one; budget/timeLimit/network/resources/licenses are plan-time config and capacity snapshots whose member names stay declared in FullPlan. `approval` is absent until `ideaseek full approve` stamps it ({at, mode, planInputHash}) onto the stored draft.
